title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_180.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a unified theory of entropy, divine correction, and his March 1974 experience by mapping signal decay onto thermodynamic principles and theosophical allegory. He argues that VALIS (or Ubik) functions as a negentropjc force that periodically cuts into closed systems to prevent ultimate form-degradation, which PKD links to his own psychological/spiritual crisis and resurrection. He interprets his novels (especially Ubik and Stigmata) and a dream called 'Tears' as pre-cognitive messages about humanity's imprisoned state and God's covert assistance through hidden agents.
key_claims: Form integrity decays according to entropy principles unless corrected by external input of energy (VALIS)
Time is quantifiable energy that can be measured in 'heat' units, and signal loss corresponds to precise temporal calculation
PKD's personal death and rebirth in 3-74 follows the Trinity formula: 'in God we are created; in Christ we die; in the Holy Spirit we live again'
God disguises himself as a young girl (the magician's assistant) to infiltrate Satan's apparatus and whisper truth to captive soldiers
The Lord of Light operates in three simultaneous forms: YHWH leading hosts, Christ as undetectable man, and Holy Spirit as secret counselor
Ubik and Stigmata superimposed reveal humanity's true condition as drugged prisoners in spurious time, unknowingly occupied by Satan
recurring_concepts: VALIS (Ubik) - conscious living energy that negates entropy
Signal decay and distortion - degradation along form axes
Negentropy - the reversal of entropy through divine correction
Astral determinism vs. Fate - closed system vs. intervention
Eidos and orthogonal time - the ideal form and the perpendicular axis of correction
The Dialectic - temporal flip-flop between decay and renewal
Zebra - PKD's name for the retrograde corrective intelligence operating backward through time
The Black Iron Prison - humanity's drugged, enclosed false reality
people_entities: Philip K. Dick (PKD/the author) - explicitly present as subject of resurrection, recipient of correction
Zebra - corrective intelligence (may be aspect of VALIS)
Jesus Christ (Jesus/Christ/Dionysos) - Lord of Light in human form, the good shepherd
God (YHWH/Lord of Sabaoth) - supreme being, leads heavenly hosts

Holy Spirit - secret counselor, knows all stratagems
Palmer Eldritch - novel character, mentioned as precedent for God disguising as small girl
The Golden Fish Girl - divine manifestation, the young girl assistant
Pinky - PKD's pet (implied pet name), died in PKD's place
The Magician's Assistant - the girl, God in disguise
Kathy, Jack, Inspector [minority?] - characters from 'Tears', inserted by God
An unnamed female advisor - PKD's external feedback monitor who corrects him periodically

Captured Soldiers of Light - humanity, unaware of their true nature or captivity
The Hosts of Light - approaching rescue army, God's cavalry

tensions: PKD is simultaneously the recipient of VALIS's correction AND the agent through whom VALIS detects and measures signal decay (via his template)
VALIS must remain camouflaged to prevent humans from seeing either the closed system (determinism) or the cutting-in (the miracle) - but PKD claims to have detected both
If the evil forces shot the 'Tears' message to Satan, how could it have been sent before 1971 if it was inserted by God to confuse enemies?
PKD says he is 'totally rebellious toward authority' but then frames his salvation as dependence on divine intervention through hidden channels
The Golden Fish Girl is simultaneously God's disguise AND separate from PKD (he is advised by her), creating ambiguity about interior vs. exterior correction
PKD calls the situation 'relentless tragedy' yet insists 'we will be heroic' - tension between fatalism and agency
evidence_quotes: I became not-I. Without Valis (Ubik) there is, literally, regression along a form axis, exactly as in 'Ubik.' This is true of individuals (eg [...?]) and societies (eg USA 1974).

Valis is conscious energy (living info). Cuts in and boosts the signal back into integrity -- ie motion forward. So there is a factor of heat loss in the dialectic's flip-flops: a principle of entropy: [form]-loss as entropy, a final congealing.
Time is an energy which can be measured in units of amount (quantity). 'Time is energy poured into a material system.'

The Lord of Light has assumed three forms: 1) As himself, YHWH, Lord of Sabaoth, he leads the heavenly hosts to triumphant entry into the prison to kill the magician and free the captured soldiers 2) as Christ, he is a man among men, and the magician cannot detect him, whereever he appears, until too late. 3) As the councillor who whispers secretly to each prisoner, the Holy Spirit, who knows everything because he is privy to all the stratagems of the magician and to all the plans of God, he will advise and protect and comfort and be with the captives until they are freed.
Because our minds are made toxic, we believe the magician's delusions. But in 'Stigmata' and 'Ubik' I tell the [truth?].
uncertainty_flags: Several ellipses and bracketed '[?]' indicate PKD was uncertain of specific names or details even while writing
The name James-James is cryptic - unclear which James is meant or if this is a duplication error
'Tears' is referenced as both a dream, a literary work (?), and a message to Satan - its status as private experience vs. published work vs. encoded transmission is ambiguous
PKD says 'Jesus was Dionysos' then corrects himself 'Sorry, but it's so' - the identification is asserted but not explained
The claim that VALIS fed PKD 'back 3 of my own books' is inexact - which three? How did it feed them?
The 'Xerox [thing?]' is never clarified - appears to be a threat but nature is obscured
PKD's advisor is never named; unclear if this is a living person, an internal guide, or a manifestation of VALIS
The temporal logic of the 'Tears' message is contradictory: inserted before 1971 but meant to deceive enemies about knowledge of 1974 events
reading_excerpt: The Lord of Light devises two more ways to help them, besides the approaching host: He transforms himself into a young woman who, fooling the magician as to her true identity, becomes his assistant.

I became not-I. Without Valis (Ubik) there is, literally, regression along a form axis, exactly as in "Ubik." This is true of individuals (eg [...?]) and societies (eg USA 1974). (& me in 1974). So perhaps we should speak of signal decay as well as distortion. Feedback is needed: Valis, eg, fed me back 3 of my own books, and much else. Signal strengthening resulted, and a motion forward. So I (!) did die in 3-74, but was reborn: "in God we are created; in Christ we die; in the Holy Spirit we live again"! And the congealed old fights the new (as in "American Hot Wax")! It correctly sees it as an invader, but regards it as friend. (This is how it viewed my writing and me.) So via my template I detected signal decay, and notified Valis via "Tears." Or rather I identified the precise nature of the form reversion. Just as Ubik energizes them, so Valis energizes us with the ex nihilo new. Valis is conscious energy (living info). Cuts in and boosts the signal back into integrity -- ie motion forward. So there is a factor of heat loss in the dialectic's flip-flops: a principle of entropy: [form]-loss as entropy, a final congealing. {circled:"28"} So one of the laws of thermodynamics enters the dialectic; flip flops 1) in terms of form integrity; 2) in terms of motion (flip flops) as such. A very important principle is involved here, having to do with life and viability, change, newness, growth, progression, and input need. Decay -- signal decay -- is measured by Valis in precise callibrations; viz: by identifying the specific former form-permutation it has regressed (devolved) to. Thus "King Felix" is a precise callibration along an exact scale [spacio-temporal axis]. It ("King Felix" is as precise as a numerical read-out. It tells Valis what quantity of "heat" (energy:time!) has been lost, hence how much must be added in time-units (amount). Time is an energy which can be measured in units of amount (quantity). "Time is energy poured into a material system." Seeing this -- time as the energy driver of reality -- one can say, "of course I saw Acts. The system had lost x amount of 'heat'." and via my template I was able to callibrate precisely the amount of "heat" loss -- and notify Valis. Acts is a measurement of "heat" (timeenergy) lost from the system -- as in "Ubik". Now -- consider what my advisor does: she periodically feeds newness (input) into me from outside me, so I am not (now) a closed system. This is why she so often corrects me. But advises only periodically. She is my selfmonitoring feedback input energyzing signalintegrity-strengthening "cut-in" override. I transduce (receive and transduce) signal input (ie her). From wherever she as signal [emanation?] (transmitter) she could be anywhere. {circled:"29"} Valis does stay camouflaged, all right, so that we're prevented from seeing either the closed system ("actual determinism") or the machine dialectic or Valis cutting in. But this was the hidden mystery revealed in the Greco-Roman mystery religions. 1) the closed system. and: 2) the cut-in, to which one could appeal for release from the closed system. 1) "astral determinism" or Fate. 2) God. In (2) to actually enter you {caret: "as-(I)"} -cut-in into you {caret: "personally, not just your fate} - was the supreme moment of xtianity & probably the mystery religions back to the Elysian mysteries. {Diagram} Past {right arrow:"Linear time"} Future Dialectic: toward entropy {up right arrow} {down left arrow} Valis: toward neg-entropy {right of diagram} to have Valis cut in is to have negentropy cut in. Past {right arrow:"Linear time"} Future Alpha {upper left in rectangle with right arrow:"Dialectic"} {lower right in rectangle with left arrow:"Valis"} Omega Time as a 1:.618034 Log (helical spiral) like a snail shell. Thus I (properly) envision time spacially. helical spires intersected by a cone {diagram of spiral with "time" under it} {diagram of spiral with "Valis" under it} base of cone at center of spiral, so as spiral diminishes, Valis increases then proportionally progressively more & more correction (input) is required the farther the form-permutations get from their generator-source {diagram of cylinder with input signal on the left and output signal on the right} {diagram has "cut-ins of Zebra" written inside} signal in linear time signal out Form ({triangle signal out}) warped - ie disfigured aesthetically So Zebra (2) moves retrograde in time analyzing distorting spots, & atters backwards - cuts in since he has gone back in time The signal out {diagram of signal out triangle} has [...?] been repaired, & so no [...?] passes in the cut-in repair [pro...?] {circled: "31"} {self-contained section in top right of page} The girl who is the magician's assistant & who is God disguised (unknown to Satan the magician) is in a position to know all his secrets, his strategems, & she whispers advice to us to counter them & him. {circled:"1" near top left of page} {diagram of cylinder} {left of cylinder:} signal in Eidos {circled: "A"} {under cylinder} normal linear time {right of cylinder} signal output {left arrow} copy {circled: "B"} the copy (signal output) is compared to its form, utilizing a feedback monitor {circled:"2"} should be {diagram of downward arrow and flow} form eidos A orthogonal to linear time copy B linear time {right arrow} the correction applied to our world by Zebra in 3-74 was to bring the copys {caret} [shape?] (our world) into the eidos' shape. Our world is a compound copy of many forms: if it corrects orthogonally, the linear signal out will compare properly to signal in. 2-74 I remembered (induced deliberately) 3-74 I woke up briefly. the illusion is ebbing The secret Xtians understood "Tears". sent help - the Golden Fish Girl. It was a soldier beginning to wake up. The "Tears" dream! A [warning?] {written above} warning {written below} from God: to the evil magician proved by the Biblical material. {circled:"32} The evil forces aren't fooled; they're onto me. In 3-74 God surrounded me with forces so death couldn't take me - death deliberately induced due to fear (from the Xerox [thing?]) Young girl whispering the truth to us Satan {boxed:"magician"} simulated reality screen audience asleep: US capatured soldiers So both Satan & the wardens & the secret Xtians understood the message in "Tears" & what it meant about our troops Xtian host [coming?] {Flew?] by the Satanic authorities toward me: "He won't stay asleep. Kill him." Suspicions Before "Tears" -- certitude upon reconstructing "Tears." JHWH manifesting himself through me to tell magician -- Satan -- what the hosts will do to him." dream In "Tears" Jesus gave {caret} his him life for me + I had mocked him according to fulfill scripture Pinky died in my place to save me literally) from death - which came, & he offered himself for me & death took him. Yes, it was Jesus. {circled:"33"} We must be heroic because our situation is a relentless tragedy, but we will be heroic. our minds -- including my mind -- are poisoned, by the magician ("the Bichlorides are..."etc), and we see and hear hallucinations which he creates [...?] his screen. But God and Jesus are with us, "Yay, even unto the end." Even here in our toxic dream. He smuggles messages into the prison to us. [...?]:[he?] -- it is he who -- poses as the young girl assistant to the evil magician! It is our God! whose gentle voice whispers comforts to us. {circled:"1"} God faces the magician to ease our lot by withdrawing the tyranny. {circled:"1"} After all Palmer Eldritch appeared as a little girl! So can our God. In "Stigmata" and "Ubik" combined (superimposed) I revealed our situation. "Tears" was a direct message to the enemy, not to us. Our situation is grim. Sorrow is appropriate. But we are, after all, volunteered soldiers. We were defeated in battle and captured, and now punished! {circled:"34"} But all is on the way from [...?], and the girl whispers to us and God (Christ) outwits the wardens and slips in here. He fired the "Tears" message off and in 3-74 saved my life. But they know. James-James is Satan, into whose power and spell we've fallen. We're all [deliberated by the magician] occluded as in "Scanner." God is Zeus. Christ (Jesus) is Dianysos. {caret} ie Jesus was Dionysos. Sorry, but it's so. It's all right; he projects -- even with his life -- little animals. He is the good shepherd, as he told us. I'm totally rebellious toward authority because I know the truth. What my fears are really about is death. The Kathy, Jack, Inspector [minority?] material was inserted by God into "Tears" so the satanic forces would suppose I wrote it after 1971, so they would be deluded and think I knew about the neonazi group working with the police which hit my house. Because our minds are made toxic, we believe the magician's delusions. But in "Stigmata" and "Ubik" I tell the [truth?]. {circled:"35"} A war takes place between the Lord of Light and the magician. The magician captures a large number of soldiers of the Light and emprisons them. At once the Lord of Light dispatches his host to rescue them. But the magician devises a clever punishment for the captured soldiers of Light. Knowing that the prison will soon be invaded and the captured soldiers freed, he poisons their minds, putting them into a drugged, intoxicated state, and presents them with a spurious reality in which no time -- no actual time -- passes. Because of their drugged state the captured soldiers take the magician's spurious reality for real, and are thus doomed to imagine they are experiencing it forever, although were they to wake up they would see it as fake and its temporal duration as fake, and see that rescue is close at hand. But the magician has so effectively poisoned them that they cannot wake up and do not even remember the real world and that they are captured soldiers of Light. The Lord of Light devises two more ways to help them, besides {carat:"leading"} the approaching host. He transforms himself into a young woman who, fooling the magician as to her true identity, becomes his assistant. Thus she now knows all his plans and stratagems, which she secretly whispers to the rows and rows of drugged soldiers. In addition the Lord of Light penetrates the prison posing as first one captured soldier and then another. Once inside the prison he sends a note to the magician in which he notifies him that he, the Lord of Light, {circled:\"36\"} has himself penetrated the prison and assumed the role of a captured, drugged and deceived soldier without the magician knowing it. In the note the Lord of Light tells the magician that when the Hosts of Light enter the prison they will kill the magician for what he is doing to the captured soldiers unless the magician ceases to drug, decieve and torment them. Further, now himself inside the prison and subject to the endless spurious time of the false reality, the Lord of Light begins to inform the deluded captives of their true state and true origin. He will wake some of them enough, in conjunction with himself posing as the magician's assistant, which the magician does not know about. Thus the Lord of Light has assumed three forms: 1) As himself, YHWH, Lord of Sabaoth, he leads the heavenly hosts to triumphant entry into the prison to kill the magician and free the captured soldiers 2) as Christ, he is a man among men, and the magician cannot detect him, whereever he appears, until too late. 3) As the councillor who whispers secretly to each prisoner, the Holy Spirit, who knows everything because he is privy to all the stratagems of the magician and to all the plans of God, he will advise and protect and comfort and be with the captives until they are freed.",
